Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped in the right lane of the northbound frontage road in Katy, Texas, when the rear of Driver 1's
vehicle was struck by Driver 2's vehicle. Driver 1 reported neck pain and stiffness consistent with whiplash and was
transported for evaluation. Officers observed rear-end damage to Driver 1's vehicle and a matching front-end impact
on Driver 2's vehicle, and the damage appears consistent with the impact described by both drivers. Scene
photographs confirm the positions of the vehilces and the general extent of the damage. No independent witnesses
were located, and no prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle is known to the reporting officer. Driver 1 is listed as the
named driver on the insurance policy for the vehicle. Passenger, seated in the rear, stated the impact was brief but
forceful. The exact seating position of Driver 1 at the moment of impact could not be fully established from statements
and physical evidence, and it remains unclear whether the reported injury resulted from this collision. Follow-up
medical records will be requested to clarify the connection.
